violations.requirement: The index passed to slice::get_unchecked must be in bounds (< slice.len()). Calling it with an out-of-bounds index is undefined behavior.
violations.explanation: `end` is computed as `(end.min(roi_ub) - roi_lb) as usize`. Callers pass `high_ask_tick` as `end`, and it can be `INVALID_MIN` when no asks exist. `end.min(roi_ub)` is then very negative, and the cast to usize gives a huge value. The loop `(start+1)..(end+1)` then runs past `depth.len()` and calls `get_unchecked(t)` with out-of-bounds `t`. The loop has no bounds check and `end` is never clamped to `len-1`.

violations.requirement: The index passed to slice::get_unchecked must be in bounds (< slice.len()). Calling it with an out-of-bounds index is undefined behavior.
violations.explanation: `start` is computed as `(start.min(roi_ub) - roi_lb) as usize` with no lower clamp. `clear_depth(Side::Buy, ..)` passes `clear_upto - 1`, which can be below `roi_lb`. The subtraction is then negative, and the cast to usize gives a huge value. The reverse loop `(end..start).rev()` starts far beyond `depth.len()` and calls `get_unchecked(t)` with out-of-bounds `t`.
